scenes.narration: This hole is nine problems away from a fallout shelter.
scenes.dominantVisual: Plain hole in the cutaway at frame 0; Tuck stands beside it with a shovel.

scenes.narration: But fallout is radioactive dust, and it falls straight in. So we add a roof.
scenes.dominantVisual: Red specks drift into the open hole; plank roof drops on.

scenes.narration: But a thin roof barely stops radiation. So we pile three feet of packed dirt on top.
scenes.dominantVisual: Red specks pass straight through the thin roof; dirt mound rises on top; 3 FT callout.

scenes.narration: But dirt is heavy, and the roof starts to sag. So we brace it with thick timber beams.
scenes.dominantVisual: Roof and dirt sag and jolt; timber posts and a beam drop in.

scenes.narration: But now there's no way in. So we dig an entrance that turns a sharp corner. Radiation hates corners. Preppers call it a baffle entry.
scenes.dominantVisual: Tuck stuck outside; an L-shaped entrance (shaft plus side passage) appears; BAFFLE ENTRY tag.

scenes.narration: But sealed underground, the air goes stale fast. So we add a hand-cranked fan and a filtered vent pipe.
scenes.dominantVisual: Stale-air badge and red specks in the sealed room; crank fan, vent pipe to the surface, teal air arrows.

scenes.narration: But you'll be down here a while. So we stock water: one gallon per person, per day.
scenes.dominantVisual: Empty shelf with a problem badge; three water jugs hop on; 1 GAL/DAY callout.
scenes.problem: no water for a long stay

scenes.narration: But what goes in must come out. So we add a lidded bucket toilet and plenty of bags.
scenes.dominantVisual: Tuck in worry pose with a problem badge; lidded bucket toilet drops into the corner.

scenes.narration: But it's pitch black. So we hang battery lanterns. Not candles, they eat your air.
scenes.dominantVisual: Night swap (time_skip into this scene); problem badge in the dark; two battery lanterns with mustard glow discs.

scenes.narration: But you can't hear the outside world. So we add a hand-crank radio. That's why the official advice is: get inside, stay inside, stay tuned.
scenes.dominantVisual: Silent question badge; crank radio on the shelf; STAY TUNED tag.

scenes.narration: And here's the surprise: fallout fades fast. After seven hours, it's ten times weaker. After two days, a hundred times.
scenes.dominantVisual: Red specks on the surface thin out in three steps; 7 HRS ÷10 then 2 DAYS ÷100 callouts.

scenes.narration: Nine problems. Nine fixes. One hole, ready for two weeks. Ready beats lucky.
scenes.dominantVisual: Static full-cutaway pull-back on the night background; Tuck cheers inside the lit shelter; READY stamp thuds on; end-card disclaimer.
